inputs.note: MODE: the real supervisor, in process — run_ask_turn with chart, document store, retriever and drafter injected. No network, no model. Harness fakes come from tests/w2_graph_support.py, which is NOT gated; the gate asserts only on the graph's own output and each check carries a control. The lab report is checked against another sample's chart, so the identity check sees a different person.

expected: A document whose patient header does not match the chart is refused as an identity mismatch; the drafter is never called and no fact from it is stated.
guards_against: A wrong-patient merge — the failure with no recovery path once it is in the chart. The drafter never running is the strongest form: there is no prose in which a value could survive.
